decision: MOA Eye is an attraction inside SM By the Bay Amusement Park, not an independent standalone venue.

evidence.finding: Pasay City Government identifies SM By the Bay Amusement Park at MOA Complex, Seaside Blvd, with multiple rides.
Current park pass lists bumper car, carousel, other rides and one MOA Eye ride in the same package.

nextAction: Search site Park records before creating or updating park; add MOA Eye as parkItem under confirmed parent.
